Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.symptoms: Foliage is dark green, firm, and glossy. Cherries develop a uniform rich color without any sunken lesions, fuzz, or powdery coatings.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Prune during the winter to maintain canopy structure, apply appropriate seasonal mulch, and follow a regular watering schedule.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: A distinct white-to-light-gray powdery fungal coating patches across leaf surfaces, causing young leaves to distort, nest, or curl upward along the margins.
treatment: Apply potassium bicarbonate, horticultural oils, or sulfur-based fungicides at the first sign of visible patches
Prune and discard highly clustered or lower shaded suckers to reduce microclimate humidity
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Ensure wide plant spacing for maximal sunlight penetration and avoid nitrogen-heavy late spring fertilization which creates overly susceptible, tender leaf flushes.
